material_omissions: No independent evaluation or regulator finding about implementation or compliance was supplied.
No source supplied a dated commitment register, targets, milestones, responsible owners, or verification evidence.
The official homepage source has no explicit source date beyond the displayed 2026 copyright and embedded July 2024–June 2025 data reference.
notes: All propositions are unreviewed model candidates derived only from the supplied frozen corpus.
Named programs and services were not treated as organization-wide commitments.

evidence.quote: Australian Red Cross is a signatory to the Australian Council for International Development (ACFID) Code of Conduct.

propositions.qualification: The report describes this as a voluntary, self-regulated sector code.
propositions.value: The organization states that it is committed through signatory status to the ACFID Code of Conduct.

evidence.quote: As a signatory we are committed and fully adhere to the Code, conducting our work with transparency, accountability, and integrity.

propositions.qualification: This is a subject-reported adherence claim; no independent verification was supplied.
propositions.value: The organization claims full adherence to the ACFID Code and describes transparency, accountability, and integrity as ways of conducting its work.

evidence.quote: This report has been prepared in accordance with Australian Accounting Standards and Interpretations

propositions.qualification: Reported by the organization in the annual report; this extraction does not independently interpret legal or accounting requirements.
propositions.value: The annual report states that it was prepared in accordance with Australian Accounting Standards and Interpretations.

evidence.quote: Our Annual Financial Statements are externally audited and more than 60 of our individual programs are separately audited and acquitted to funders each year.

propositions.population: Annual financial statements and more than 60 individual programs
propositions.qualification: The report claims these audit and acquittal practices; underlying audit reports were not supplied.
propositions.value: The organization reports external audit of annual financial statements and separate audit and funder acquittal of more than 60 programs each year.

evidence.quote: Join thousands of regular givers helping us deliver continued support before, during and after disaster.

propositions.qualification: A general public-facing fundraising and support statement; it does not specify a quantified commitment or delivery guarantee.
propositions.value: The organization invites regular giving to support continued assistance before, during, and after disasters.
